Rather than operating as a traditional support organization, the team works alongside engineers to establish modern engineering practices, accelerate platform adoption, remove developer friction, and bring real-world feedback into the platform roadmap. This is a high-profile, highly collaborative leadership role with significant visibility across the technology organization. Success is not simply measured by deploying tools. The Embedded Platform Engineering team is a dedicated engineering organization, not floating or ticket-based support. jobs.title: Senior Combustion Devices Engineer II
jobs.description_text: NEUTRON Neutron is a medium-lift launch vehicle being developed by Rocket Lab, a publicly traded end-to-end space company. The rocket can deliver the mega constellations of tomorrow, enable interplanetary payloads, and support human spaceflight. As a reusable platform, Neutron will deliver a very cost-effective and reliable launch solution leveraging Rocket Lab’s proven history with Electron – the third most launched rocket, worldwide, in 2024. If you’re interested in joining an incredible team in a fast-paced and rewarding environment, this is your opportunity. SENIOR COMBUSTION DEVICES ENGINEER II / PRINCIPAL COMBUSTION DEVICES ENGINEER Based out of Rocket Lab's headquarters in Long Beach, CA, the Principal/Senior Combustion Devices Engineer will be responsible for the development of one or more combustion devices (preburners, main injectors, thrust chambers assemblies and vacuum nozzles). These devices are an integral portion of the 200,000 lbf Archimedes engine, which operates in a demanding but efficient ox-rich, staged combustion architecture. In this role, you’ll take ownership of all aspects of a component: design and analysis, manufacturing and test support, and successful flights and subsequent, high-cadence, re-flights. This person will partner with Data, Product, and Revenue Technology to understand the data available across Google Analytics, HubSpot, and Salesforce, bring those sources into a consistent reporting view, and build the dashboards marketing needs to measure performance and make better decisions. The role will also own marketing attributes, the data points used to identify meaningful customer groups and support targeted campaigns. Working closely with Product and Engineering, this person will understand how attributes are defined and used, represent Marketing when attributes change, and help campaign teams apply them effectively. This is a hands-on analytics and reporting role, not a software or data engineering position. Success requires strong data judgment, practical reporting and dashboard-building skills, a clear understanding of how business systems connect, and the ability to translate stakeholder needs into useful reporting. Own marketing analytics and reporting. Serve as the main point of contact for marketing performance data, dashboards, recurring reporting, and measurement questions. Establish clear metric definitions and reporting standards so teams use a consistent view of performance. Understand and connect the data. This role owns workflow management, project intake, and process optimization to keep marketing’s initiatives on track and aligned with the team’s priorities. This role also builds and maintains the operational systems that keep marketing running smoothly day to day, and is responsible for developing scalable processes that support organizational growth and execution excellence. This role reports to the Vice President, Marketing Operations, and serves as the operational backbone of the marketing organization, providing visibility into all active initiatives, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring efficient collaboration across marketing, sales, product, and other business stakeholders to keep projects moving, working up and across the organization. The ideal candidate has a track record of building the systems and structure a marketing team runs on, including designing the frameworks and processes that let multiple workstreams move at once, driving measurable gains in efficiency through process improvement, and maintaining the trackers and dashboards that give the organization one clear, reliable picture of what's in progress. jobs.description_text: About the team Before Stripe, every growing internet platform needed a payments team. Today, every growing internet platform needs a way to establish trust in its users. Identity verification is a core piece of economic infrastructure for online businesses. Stripe Identity enables businesses to digitally verify their users through identity documents and other signals for fraud prevention, regulatory, and trust and safety use cases. We are building the future of identity verification and trust in the digital economy. The Identity Product Experience team owns Stripe Identity’s mobile SDKs for iOS, Android, and React Native. These SDKs enable businesses to embed secure, high-quality identity-verification experiences directly in their mobile applications. Stripe's Revenue Suite helps businesses monetize however their customers want to buy: subscription, usage-based, or hybrid pricing. As monetization models get more complex and pricing becomes something companies iterate on continuously rather than set once, this team sits at the center of how Stripe helps businesses price, bill, recognize, and report on revenue.
